svg.title: The UCX provider's fifteen record types on the context, worker, endpoint ownership spine, and the four ucx_deep records beneath them
svg.desc: Hand-authored layout, emitted by tools/gen_figures.py. The record set was cross-checked against the COMSHU_RECORD declarations by hand; nothing enforces it.
svg.text: The spine is ownership: a context owns
Which side a call hangs off is the API's own
shape, not a convention. A tagged send names
its endpoint; a tagged receive cannot, because
it matches by tag across every peer at once.
ucx_tag_probe carries the one true byte count
in this family. Every other count is capacity
exist only to make the cross-rank join

g.text: UCX_DEEP / UCT 800–899 — WHAT UCX DID ABOUT IT

svg.text: The 600s and the 800s are joined on the TAG, by the reader's tag_flow, not by
a field — the join is per (rank, tag), never per message. Untagged doors carry
the tag inside an AM payload and stay unjoinable; uct_ep is a LANE, not a QP.
